//: Composite indexes for the resume queries in common/metadata.py. Without these, Firestore rejects the ordered queries with FailedPrecondition and resume falls back to a slow path. Deploy with: gcloud firestore indexes create --index-file=firestore.indexes.json (or `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`).

indexes.//: latest_downloaded(): last document written = how far the descending sweep got = the resume cursor.
highest_downloaded(): highest-ranked document = the frontier that new material appears above.
